To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the Epsl library has been extended to support the representation and solving of P&S problems with state variables, renewable resources, and a hierarchical structure of timelines; (ii) the Epslsolver has been enhanced by the introduction of a domain-independent heuristic function that exploits a hierarchical structure of the timelines; (iii) a case study in the field of manufacturing has been used to empirically evaluate the effectiveness of the Epsl extensions.

(a) Epsl is a flexible framework for developing P&S applications, (b) the hierarchical structure of a flexible plan can be exploited to speed up the solving process, (c) Epsl can be used to solve real world P&S problems.
(i) the integration of Planning and scheduling techniques in the Epsl architecture is feasible and (ii) the proposed hierarchical heuristic function is effective and efficient.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a flexible and extensible framework supporting P&S applications, and with the design of a hierarchical heuristic function to support the planning process.
the development of a framework for the design of flexible P&S applications.

the design of a P&S framework that is able to deal with the complexity of real problems by integrating the most suitable techniques and exploiting the hierarchical structure that can be found in many real applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed approach is a valid and promising solution for P&S problems in the manufacturing domain.
this work is the first step toward a complete integration of planning and scheduling in a flexible timeline based framework.
the Epsl based approach can be successfully deployed in the solving of real world problems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed approach allows to solve P&S problem in a more effective way, by integrating the reasoning on resources, state variables and the hierarchical structure of timelines in a flexible plan.
Epsl is a flexible and extensible framework for solving real world P&S problems.
Epsl is a promising approach to solve P&S in the context of real world manufacturing applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a tight integration of different P&S techniques can be achieved by exploiting a domain independent flexible timeline representation and a hierarchical planning heuristic.
the integration of Planning and scheduling techniques can be effectively exploited in a domain independent framework to solve real world problems.
the Epsl approach can be successfully applied in a real world context to solve P&S problem.
